page: Microsoft Azure D2pls_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the 64-bit ARM architecture. It runs on Microsoft Hyper-V and is powered by a dedicated 3.4 GHz Microsoft ARM Neoverse-N2 processor providing 2 physical cores and 2 vCPUs without simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation is set at 4.0 GB of RAM, equating to 2.0 GB per core. The processor features 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 128 MB of shared L3 cache, with hardware cryptographic acceleration via AES. The instance does not include integrated GPUs or local instance storage, requiring remote storage solutions for persistent data.

Benchmark evaluations highlight a profile governed by low core density alongside capable single-threaded execution. In single-threaded compression tests, the instance records strong performance, reaching 33.08 GB/sec in gzip compression. Single-core tests in stress-ng (2073.69) and Geekbench (1683.0) place within average percentiles. However, aggregate throughput is constrained by the two-core allocation. Multi-core stress-ng scores (4127.28), multi-core Geekbench results (3085.0), and PassMark CPU metrics (2018.86) reflect weak relative performance. Memory bandwidth reaches 47.37 GB/sec on uncached reads but drops to 20.82 GB/sec on writes, which limits high-throughput I/O execution such as Redis SET operations (4.16 million ops/sec) and static web delivery (4.03 GB/sec).

From a resource and efficiency standpoint, the D2pls_v6 offers an entry-tier ARM environment with dedicated compute slices. The absence of local storage and a modest 4.0 GB memory footprint make it unsuited for heavy memory-resident datasets or high-concurrency tasks. It serves primarily lightweight containerized services, edge tasks, CI/CD runners, basic web microservices, and general development or testing environments targeting ARM64 execution.
description: The Microsoft Azure D2pls_v6 is a virtual server instance powered by a 2-core ARM Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is equipped with 2 dedicated vCPUs, 4.0 GB of system memory (2.0 GB per vCPU), and 128 MB of L3 cache, while omitting local storage and GPU hardware. Benchmark evaluations show capable single-threaded throughput, notably achieving 33.08 GB/sec in gzip compression and average-tier Geekbench single-core performance. Conversely, multi-core capacity and memory throughput remain restricted by the two-thread limit, leading to below-average results in overall CPU, memory bandwidth, and Redis operations. The low memory density and lack of bundled disks position this instance as a cost-efficient entry point for ARM-targeted computing. The D2pls_v6 is best suited for lightweight web microservices, small CI/CD build workers, development and testing environments, and basic ARM64 containerized workloads.
